name: github_list_repos
description: List repositories the authenticated user can access, INCLUDING private repos (the token's scope decides what is visible). Returns an array of {full_name, private, default_branch, description, pushed_at, ...}. Use this to discover repos before reading or writing them. Optional `visibility` ('all' default, 'public', or 'private'), `affiliation` (default 'owner,collaborator,organization_member'), and `per_page` (default 30, max 100); results are sorted by most recently updated.

visibility.description: Which repos to return by visibility. Defaults to 'all'.

affiliation.description: Comma-separated affiliations, e.g. 'owner', 'collaborator', 'organization_member'. Defaults to all three.
